title: AWS is rolling out Resilient Network Graphs, a "quasi-random" networking architecture that uses a flat mesh design, and says it accelerates information flows (Lauren Goode/Wired)
summary: Lauren Goode / Wired: AWS is rolling out Resilient Network Graphs, a “quasi-random” networking architecture that uses a flat mesh design, and says it accelerates information flows — The tech giant says a breakthrough in data-center networking has dramatically accelerated the flow of information through its massive cloud infrastructure.
